findings.title: SPAK përfundon operacionin kundër tregut të paligjshëm kibernetik RYDOX, arreston 3 administratorët e tij (NJOFTIM PËR SHTYP, Datë 12.12.2024)
findings.summary_md: Albania's Special Anti-Corruption and Organized Crime Structure (SPAK) announced operation RYDOX on 12 December 2024, arresting three administrators including Kosovo citizen Sh.S. (Shpend Sokoli), who resided in Albania. It states Rydox made over 7,600 sales since February 2016 generating at least $230,000, offered more than 321,372 cybercrime products to an 18,000-user base, and sold names, addresses, Social Security numbers, card data, and login credentials of thousands of people residing in the United States. Seizures listed: one computer, six laptops, five mobile phones, other storage devices, documents, and cryptocurrency assets, while US authorities seized the www.Rydox.cc domain. Partners named include the FBI's Pittsburgh office, Albania's BKH, Kosovo's Special Prosecution and Police, and the Royal Malaysia Police.

findings.title: Rydox Cybercrime Marketplace Disrupted, Administrators Arrested
findings.summary_md: First-day coverage of the US takedown announcement: Ardit Kutleshi, 26, and Jetmir Kutleshi, 28, were arrested in Kosovo and awaiting extradition, while Shpend Sokoli was arrested in Albania to be prosecuted there. Per the indictment, Rydox was active since at least February 2016, with more than 7,600 sales generating at least $230,000, at least 321,372 products listed, and over 18,000 users. The US seized the www.Rydox.cc domain, seized servers in Malaysia with local police, and obtained authorization to seize approximately $225,000 in cryptocurrency.

findings.title: Kosovar Administrator of Cybercrime Marketplace Extradited to US
findings.summary_md: Coverage of the parallel BlackDB.cc case (admin Liridon Masurica, extradited 9 May 2025) that also fixes the Rydox timeline: Ardit Kutleshi and Jetmir Kutleshi were extradited to the US in early April 2025 after their December 2024 arrests in Kosovo, and Shpend Sokoli was arrested in Albania the same month. The December 2024 Kosovo operation against both marketplace admins came out of FBI-led investigations with Kosovo Police's Cybercrime Investigation Directorate.
